sentences.text:
Unknown vs Chhotu Lal And Ors. V. Union Of India And ... on 7
January, 2025

Bench: Sandeep Sharma
Chhotu Lal and Ors. v. Union of India and Ors.
Cwp No.2652 of 2024 07.1.2025

Present: Mr. Charanpal Singh, Advocate, (through Video
Conferencing) with Mr. Parkshit Sharma, Advocate, for the petitioners.
Mr. Rajender Thakur, Central Government Counsel for respondent No.1.
Mr. K.D. Shreedhar, Senior Advocate with Ms. Shreya Chauhan, Advocate, for respondent No.2.
Mr. Hem Raj Thakur and Mr. Nisheet Sharma, Advocates, for respondent No.3.

Mr. Rajan Kahol, Mr. Vishal Panwar and Mr. B.C. Verma, Additional Advocates General with Mr.
Ravi Chauhan, Deputy Advocate General, for respondents No. 4 to 6/State

Replies on behalf of
respondents No.1 to 3 are on record.
No reply has been filed by respondents No. 4 to 6.
Last opportunity of six weeks, as prayed for, is granted to the afore respondents to file reply, failing which, they would remain present in the Court on the next date of hearing.

Since it is quite apparent from the pleadings adduced on record by the petitioners as well as other appearing respondents that till date no steps have been taken by the respondents for preparation of Rehabilitation and Settlement Scheme under Schedule 2 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, as a result thereof,
petitioners whose properties already stand taken over have been rendered landless, this court deems it fit to direct respondents No. 3 to 6 to ensure that on or before the next date of hearing steps, if any, are taken towards preparation of aforesaid Scheme and compliance report in that regard is placed on record so that appropriate orders are passed on the next date of hearing.
